figures.caption: Fig. 1. Cross-depth expert augmentation and staged comparisons. Cross-depth AttnRes combines earlier CBraMod states before the final representation is processed by two separate soft-routed expert banks in parallel with the shared FFN. The lower panel summarizes the evaluated stages: Full FT, +AttnRes, and +AttnRes + Experts.

Fig. 2. Mean changes in class-wise recall over three matched seeds. The first row shows AttnRes minus Full FT and the second shows the complete model minus AttnRes; values are descriptive percentage-point changes, and the shared diverging color scale is centered at zero and spans −12 to +12.
